criteria.label: Accuracy & Source Traceability
criteria.finding: All 5 cited evidence record(s) trace cleanly to validated mission sources without contradiction.

criteria.label: Package Section Completeness
criteria.finding: All required commercial, technical, pricing-estimate, scope, risk, and assumption sections present.

criteria.label: Visual & Semantic Design Quality
criteria.finding: Uses semantic HTML5 landmarks (<header>, <main>, <footer>) and structured CSS design tokens.

criteria.label: Interactive Control Functionality
criteria.finding: Contains functional preview form controls and valid internal/verified anchors.

criteria.label: Accessibility & Form Usability
criteria.finding: Primary <h1> hierarchy and explicit <label for="..."> accessibility bindings verified.

criteria.label: Mobile Viewport & Responsive CSS
criteria.finding: Verified <meta name="viewport"> and @media mobile breakpoint rules without fixed desktop overflow.

criteria.label: Technical & Preview Isolation Consistency
criteria.finding: Valid HTML5 doctype, <title>, and noindex,nofollow preview isolation directive present.

criteria.label: Zero Unsupported / Fabricated Claims
criteria.finding: No fabricated testimonials, unverified ROI guarantees, or synthetic performance claims detected.

criteria.label: Deliverable Security Hygiene
criteria.finding: Passed static security scan (zero eval/document.write/inline XSS/leaked keys; outbound automation disabled).
